comment: The real-time sentiment watchdog is game-changing! Caught the TSLA sentiment shift right before the Q3 earnings call.
Extremely impressive AI orchestration. The sub-agent thought stream gives complete transparency into how sentiment scores are calculated.
Love the stock price vs sentiment overlay charts. Would love to see support for crypto tickers and European index options in future updates.
Seamless integration with Razorpay UPI payments for Pro Trader subscription. Clean UI design and lightning-fast websocket chat response.
The dark mode aesthetic is top-notch, but initial watchlist aggregation latency can occasionally spike during high news volume hours.
The 18-topic granular sentiment breakdown (layoffs, board changes, disputes, ESG) provides insights that raw news summaries completely miss.
Great financial AI copilot. Answers detailed questions on market trends effortlessly. Highly recommended for daily market monitoring.
Solid platform overall. Suggest adding export functionality for sentiment history as CSV so we can pipe data into custom models.
The real-time WebSocket sentiment heatmap streaming gives our desk an edge during early morning market opens. Remarkable accuracy.
The Gemini 2.5 integration provides concise, context-aware macro summaries without the fluff. Very clean UI interface.
